subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `openclaw memory status` report builtin vector-store readiness from persisted `vectorDims` metadata without loading sqlite-vec in that process?
rationale: This is a compatibility and operator-semantics choice because the PR changes CLI/JSON status meaning while leaving `--deep` as the live probe path.
